texts.missionStart.generic.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Picture hostile. Weapons free.
texts.missionStart.generic.1: Overlord to Viper 1. Bandits on scope. Cleared hot.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Three bandits over the Seine. Weapons free.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.1: Picture: three hostiles, Tower to Montmartre. Clean them up.
texts.missionStart.generic.2: Viper 1, you are on station. Commence sweep.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.2: Paris is closed airspace until those three are in the river. Go.
texts.missionStart.baycap.1: Hostiles over San Francisco. Fog at dusk. Be done before it.
texts.missionStart.baycap.0: Viper 1, five bandits over the Bay, Financial District to the Golden Gate. Sweep it clean.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.0: Viper 1, bandits in the valley, El Cap to Half Dome. Mind the granite.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.1: Five hostiles low in Yosemite. Terrain masks both ways down there.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.2: Valley is hot. Watch your altitude. Those walls are a kilometer tall.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.0: Viper 1, five bandits hold the Loop. Splash them in the towers, egress over the lake.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.1: Chicago under siege, Willis to Navy Pier. Thread the towers.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.2: Five contacts on the lakefront. Take the sky back.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.0: Viper 1, six bandits own Manhattan, WTC to the Park. Take it back.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.2: Six contacts. Manhattan Fury is a go. Good hunting.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.1: Six hostiles over New York. Extract at Liberty when the sky is clean.
texts.missionStart.southampton.1: Five contacts on the South Fork. Try not to part anyone’s hair on Meadow Lane.
texts.missionStart.southampton.0: Viper 1, bandits over the Hamptons, Shinnecock to Coopers Beach. Low and fast.
texts.missionStart.southampton.2: Beach sweep. Five bandits, inlet to the estates. Weapons free.
texts.allClear.1: All bandits down. Get to the portal.
texts.allClear.0: Splash the last one. Picture clean! Extraction is open.

texts.shieldsCritical.0: Last shield! One more and you’re going down!
texts.shieldsCritical.1: Shields critical! Do not take another hit!
texts.victory.0: Viper 1 through the portal. Mission complete. Drinks are on Overlord.
texts.victory.2: Skies cleared, pilot recovered. Well done.
texts.down.0: Viper 1 is down! I say again, Viper 1 is down!
texts.down.1: We lost Viper 1. Mark the crash site.
texts.spoofed.0: Flares! Your bird went for the flares. Get closer, or go guns.
texts.spoofed.1: Spoofed. Seeker chased a flare. Press in.
texts.spoofed.2: Negative hit, that was a flare. Close the range.
texts.gunsKill.0: Guns kill! Guns kill! All pilot, Viper 1.
texts.gunsKill.1: Splash one with the cannon. Nobody spoofs a bullet.
texts.gunsKill.2: Guns, guns, guns. And he’s down!
texts.winchester.0: Viper 1, you’re Winchester. Go guns, or hit the portal to rearm.
texts.winchester.1: Rails empty. Cannon only, or run for the portal.
texts.rearm.0: Rearm complete. Six on the rails. Get back in there.
texts.winchester.2: Last missile gone. Guns, or rearm at extraction.
texts.rearm.2: Six fresh missiles. Make them count.
texts.checkSix.0: Check six, Viper 1! Bandit on your tail!
texts.checkSix.1: Break! He’s on your six, closing!
texts.checkSix.2: One on your six! Turn hard!
texts.wingKill.0: Splash one! That one’s mine, Lead.
texts.wingKill.2: He’s down! Two’s got a kill.
texts.check.0: Overlord reading you loud and clear, Viper 1.
